privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The Facil platform is an independent digital service that helps its users prepare, organize and track their administrative procedures and fiscal obligations in Equatorial Guinea. Facil is not operated by any public administration. This policy describes how we collect, use and protect your personal data in accordance with applicable regulations.
privacy.dataCollectedContent: We collect the data needed for the platform to help you prepare and manage your procedures: full name, identity document, tax identification number, address, email, phone number, and the information you voluntarily provide when preparing a declaration or request.
privacy.purposeContent:
Your data is used to:
- Allow you to prepare, organize and track your procedures from the platform
- Facilitate the calculation and preparation of your declarations
- Store your documents in your encrypted digital vault
- Send operational communications regarding your account and ongoing procedures
- Verify your identity and prevent fraud
- Continuously improve the platform's services
privacy.legalBasisContent: Processing is based on the consent you give upon registering and using each service, on the performance of the platform's terms of use, and on Facil's legitimate interest in ensuring the security and improvement of the service. When you choose to send information to a public entity via the platform, subsequent processing by that entity is governed by its own data protection regulations.
privacy.retentionContent: Your personal data is retained while your account is active. After account deletion, data is permanently deleted within 30 days, except for data you have requested to keep for your personal archives. Certain operational logs (security logs, encrypted backups) may be retained for up to 5 years for traceability and security purposes.
privacy.sharingContent:
Your data may be shared only with:
- The entities receiving a procedure, only when you choose to send them information through the platform
- Payment service providers, only when you choose to pay through the platform, and limited to processing the transaction
- Technology providers (hosting, security, technical analytics) under confidentiality and data-processing agreements

No data is shared with third parties for commercial or advertising purposes.
privacy.rightsContent: You have the right to access, rectify, and request deletion of your personal data, as well as to restrict or object to its processing. To exercise these rights, contact support through the platform or at the address indicated below.
privacy.securityContent: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data: encrypted communications (TLS), secure storage with encryption at rest, two-factor authentication (2FA), role-based access control (RBAC), and access auditing.
privacy.contactContent: For inquiries about data protection, you can contact us through the platform's support module or by email at facilege26@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using the Facil platform, you accept the following terms and conditions governing access to and use of the digital services offered by the platform.
terms.acceptanceContent: Registration and use of the Facil platform implies full acceptance of these terms. If you disagree, you must not use the services. Continued use after modifications constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.servicesContent:
Facil provides you with digital tools to help you:
- Prepare and submit your tax declarations (VAT, income tax, corporate tax and others)
- Prepare administrative procedure requests (identity documents, permits, licenses and others)
- Manage your commercial licenses and personal fiscal obligations
- Track the status of procedures and payments initiated from the platform
- Schedule appointments at the relevant offices when this functionality is available

Facil acts as an assistance tool. Administrative decisions and the final validity of procedures are the responsibility of the relevant entities.
terms.accountContent: The user is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their access credentials. All activity performed with your account will be considered as done by you. In case of unauthorized access, you must notify us immediately through the support module.
terms.obligationsContent:
The user agrees to:
- Provide truthful, accurate, and up-to-date information
- Not use the platform for fraudulent or illegal purposes
- Comply with their own tax obligations established by applicable law
- Not attempt to access unauthorized data or functionalities
- Respect legal deadlines for declarations and payments to the relevant entities
terms.intellectualPropertyContent: All proprietary platform content (software, design, original texts and Facil's logos) is the property of Facil and its licensors. Reproduction, distribution or modification without express authorization is prohibited. Logos, trademarks or references to public entities mentioned for informational purposes belong to their respective owners.
terms.limitationsContent: The platform is provided with the greatest possible diligence. However, uninterrupted service availability is not guaranteed. Facil shall not be liable for damages resulting from technical interruptions, transmission errors or force majeure. Tax calculations are indicative and must be validated by the user before official submission. Facil does not replace professional tax advice and does not guarantee the final outcome of the procedure with the relevant entity.
terms.modificationsContent: We reserve the right to modify these terms. Modifications will be published on this page with the update date. Substantial changes will be notified to registered users by email.
terms.jurisdictionContent: These terms are governed by the legislation of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea. The courts of Malabo shall have jurisdiction for dispute resolution.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how the Facil platform uses cookies and similar technologies to ensure proper service operation.
cookies.whatAreContent: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They allow us to remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.
cookies.typesContent:
Essential cookies: necessary for platform operation (authentication, session, CSRF security). They cannot be disabled.

Preference cookies: store your preferred language (Spanish, French, or English) and display settings.

Performance cookies: help us understand how the platform is used to improve its operation. They do not collect personally identifiable information.
cookies.purposeContent:
Cookies are used to:
- Keep your session securely logged in
- Remember your preferred language
- Protect against CSRF attacks
- Improve performance and user experience
- Remember the state of your in-progress forms
cookies.thirdPartyContent: The platform may include cookies from third-party services for payment processing (BANGE) and performance analytics. These services have their own privacy policies.
cookies.managementContent: You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling essential cookies will prevent normal use of the platform, including logging in and completing procedures.
cookies.contactContent: For inquiries about cookie usage, you can contact us through the platform's support module.

accountDeletion.title: Account & data deletion
accountDeletion.intro: Pursuant to Article 17 of the GDPR ("right to erasure"), you may request deletion of your Facil account and the associated personal data at any time. This page describes the available methods, timelines, and data categories involved.

warning.title: Warning: deletion is irreversible after the grace period
warning.body: Once the 30-day window has elapsed, deleted data cannot be recovered. We recommend exporting your important documents beforehand from the "My document vault" section.

accountDeletion.fromMobileIntro: If you have the app installed and can sign in, this is the fastest method:

steps.openApp: Open the Facil app on your phone.
steps.openProfile: Tap the "Profile" tab in the bottom bar.
steps.dangerZone: Scroll to the "Danger zone" section at the bottom of the profile.
steps.confirmPassword: Tap "Delete my account" and enter your current password.
steps.typeDelete: Type the word "DELETE" (uppercase) in the confirmation field.
steps.confirmFinal: Tap the red "Confirm deletion" button. You will receive an email confirmation.

accountDeletion.fromWebIntro: If you prefer the web version, sign in and follow the same procedure under Settings > Account > Delete account.
accountDeletion.fromEmailIntro: If you can no longer access the app or website (forgotten password and recovery email unreachable), email us from the address registered on your account:
accountDeletion.emailBodyTemplate:
I request the full deletion of my Facil account and the associated personal data, pursuant to GDPR art. 17.

Full name: [your name]
Registered email: [your email]
Last 4 digits of ID document (DIP/Passport): [optional]

I confirm I have read the policy on retained mandatory tax data.
accountDeletion.emailResponseTime: We will process your request within 5 business days. We will ask for an ID document to verify the legitimacy of the request before deletion.

lifecycle.immediate: Immediately: your account is deactivated, all active sessions are closed across all devices, and your access tokens are revoked. You will no longer be able to sign in.
lifecycle.gracePeriod: For 30 days: data is kept in "soft-deleted" state as a safety measure. If this was a mistake, contact support to reactivate the account.
lifecycle.finalPurge: After the 30-day window: an automated process permanently deletes all eligible data. This operation is irreversible.
